title: Parse INI-style config text
description: Implement parse_config(text). Parse INI-style configuration text into a dict mapping section names to dicts of key/value strings. Lines are split on newlines. Blank lines and full-line comments (first non-space character is '#' or ';') are skipped. A section header is a line whose stripped form is '[' + name + ']'. Any other non-skipped line must contain '=' and sets key = value in the current section, with key and value stripped of surrounding whitespace. Raise ValueError on a key/value line before any section, on a non-comment line without '=', on a malformed or empty section header, and on an empty key.
invariants: Keys and values are stripped of surrounding whitespace; inner whitespace and '=' characters inside the value are preserved (split on the first '=' only).
A repeated key inside one section overwrites the earlier value.
A repeated section header merges into the existing section instead of replacing it.
ValueError on: key/value line before any section, non-comment line without '=', malformed section header (missing ']' or empty name), empty key.
Inline comments after a value are NOT special: the comment text is part of the value.
